title: ½ Price Weet-Bix 575g $2.50 @ Woolworths
body:
Deal: ½ Price Weet-Bix 575g $2.50 @ Woolworths

[DiscountAcquired] High in glyphosate too apparently, our standards allow 15x more then New Zealand.
[RecklessMonkeys] Would that not be true of all our crops?
[Nom] High ?
The study you are referring to, found the level at about one tenth of what Australia considers safe.
This is the opposite of high 🤷
If you want to campaign to reduce Australia's safety limit then let's find some evidence that it needs reducing, and then do that - there's no need to spread falsehoods.
[chrismheath] Ah that's why they taste so much better here
[starionx] Than what… cardboard? My money is on the cardboard. I've been eating weet-bix for years, but to suggest that it has a good taste… well that's just an oxymoron.
[Mjk698] That's why you use milk, sugar, honey, whatever you need
[gcheap] @Mjk698: Back in my day we had weetbix and hot water.
[unison] Isn't that the same product they sell in NZ?
[Naigrabzo] Just as well because NZ is poorer than us.
[Bullion78] They've annoyingly pulled the Organic variety. Refuse to buy it now, and any others for that reason.
[auna] Man, that’s a shame. One of the very best cereals and I’d occasionally purchase it when normal weet-bix wasn’t on special.
However I imagine when people compared the cost of the normal and organic they wouldn’t justify the price difference.
[will05] Yum yum , someone made cup cakes from weet bix
[Mjk698] Millions of Aussies born and bred on the good old weetbix…
Weetbix were often breakfast lunch and tea growing up in the country 😋
"mum I'm hungry…there's plenty of Weetbix left over now shut your yapping son…" While mum and dad sucked back their VBs and Winnie blues 😂 😂 oh the memories
